title: Empty the Trash in Finder to free disk space
summary: Permanently delete everything in the Trash with a keyboard shortcut in Finder. This frees disk space, and the items cannot be recovered afterwards.

aliases.text: free up disk space mac trash
mac trash can empty keyboard shortcut

steps.explain: Press Shift+Command+Delete in Finder to empty the Trash. A confirmation dialog appears; click Empty Trash to delete the items for good. Empty the Trash only when you no longer need anything in it, because Finder cannot undo this.
steps.gui: In Finder press Shift+Command+Delete, or Control-click the Trash icon in the Dock and choose Empty Trash. Option+Shift+Command+Delete skips the confirmation dialog.
steps.expect: A confirmation dialog appears. After you click Empty Trash, the Trash icon shows as empty and the disk space is freed.

rollback.explain: There is no undo for emptied items. Restore them only from a backup, such as Time Machine, if you made one before emptying the Trash.

warnings: Emptying the Trash permanently deletes its items. Finder cannot undo this.
Option+Shift+Command+Delete skips the confirmation dialog, so check the Trash contents first.
Move anything you still need out of the Trash before you empty it.
